pages.title: Tardigrade Culture
pages.text: A culture of water bears, tiny eight-legged animals that survive vacuum, radiation and freezing by drying out and simply pausing being alive. In the jar they wander slowly through moss. Dried, they will wait for centuries.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Extremophiles taught me that life could survive almost anything. I used engineered enzymes to boost a tardigrade genome's repair genes, gave them moss to live in and froze a culture in superfluid helium. It woke up.
